rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; pre-training used TractoInferno data acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites (plus fine-tuning on NIMHANS CN).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Normative model training used TractoInferno and NIMHANS CN datasets; neither is in the predefined EPD list.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites." "Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset, randomly selected and stratified by sex and scanner, were then used to fine-tune the model for 5000 steps."
